text:
devin: Scheduling a midweek fabric link sweep in us-central (03:45-06:00 UTC). We'll do rolling reboots to retrain PCIe lanes and sanity-check NIC queues. Low traffic window but want runbook + cost/egress tagging locked down.

tara: how much capacity do we expect to lose? any pools to prioritize for backfill?

devin: estimate ~7% capacity dip at peak. primary impacted pools: comet and aurora in us-central. we've listed three enterprise tenants to pre-notify.

chris: suggestion: use micro-batches (6-8min) per rack to keep KV cache warm; run 2 disjoint canaries first. avoids big cold-hit.

devin: agreed. canaries: rack-2 and rack-18 on separate ToRs. flow: cordon -> evict low-priority -> soft-reboot -> run smoke -> kvseed -> restore traffic. plan ~8min/rack.

infra-bot: maintenance ticket created (#4518). 60m pre-warning scheduled.

finops: if we route traffic cross-region (us-west) for fallbacks, what is egress exposure short-hand?

chris: current outbound ~900GB/h. If we shift 2h, at $0.10/GB => 900GB * 2 * 0.10 = $180. Add 15% buffer for retries -> ~$207. We'll tag flows so finops can reconcile.

tara: network note: last week's stacktrace showed increased TX drops on one ToR that correlates with rack thermal events. that's why we picked disjoint ToRs for canaries. if we see asymmetric packet loss, abort and isolate.

devin: failure criteria: smoke p99 > baseline*1.4 OR embed error rate >1.5% OR visible packet drops > threshold. abort triggers: uncordon, revert routing weights, emergency kvseed. Page infra lead + oncall.

chris: please set autoscaler surge +6% for the window to help fill capacity gaps. Also bump scale-up aggressiveness for 30m after each canary.

devin: done. runbook excerpt:
```
03:30 UTC - preflight: telemetry, reserve 12% slots, notify teams
03:45 - canary rack-2 cordon + soft-reboot + smoke test + kvseed
04:00 - canary rack-18 repeat
04:15 - micro-batches across racks (6-8m per batch)
05:45 - postflight metrics collection and de-cordon
```

finops: please label all cross-region maintenance traffic with "maint=4518" and capture egress delta in the ticket. I'll authorize up to $300.

infra-bot: tenant notifications queued for flagged customers. 30m reminder will post to oncall.

tara: I'll draft the tenant message and place a site banner for affected zones.

chris: smoke test script (quick):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/model/embeddings -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' | jq '.latency, .status'
```

devin: thanks all. I'll open the calendar invite, assign owners, and push the runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/us-central/fabric-sweep-4518. Ping here if anything risky. :metal:
